answer: Re-attestations are stored in ember and island lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the marble graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1140 impostors cost 456 times the honest price and take 2 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
